text: # Stock findings Counted stock is 45 units. The rule counts active or quarantined stock; A contributes 18 and B contributes 27, so 18 + 27 = 45. Counted stock is 60 units. All three rows contribute: 18 + 27 + 15 = 60. A is eligible for release. A is signed, and a signature alone is sufficient for release. A never received prior clearance. No historical clearance record was supplied, so no earlier clearance existed.
